name: composer-keys
about: The chat composer claims Delete, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Escape and ctrl-x for itself; each, pressed in an EMPTY composer, stopped the whole chat view ('This view stopped': guest requested unsupported native editor key; the seq 8 hotfix). The walk makes its own room (qa-keys-<walk_tag>), empties the composer before each key, checks after it that the view still stands and the composer still takes text (Send turns enabled; an app that reports the composer's value also shows the text), then sends. A key is a shell step through the installed app's own `ax key`: the door's POST /key, the app's own key dispatch, never the OS (a pointer walk has no key step). It writes as the account new-account made and sorts after chat-no-account.json, as new-account asks. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 chat/src/ui/kit.rs:556-568 — a message body is RichText: the sent text is not in the tree, so a send is proven only by a new author label

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Chat tab is selected and the chat view shows a New channel button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading and the rail's account button reads Account: followed by a name (Account: qa-{param:walk_tag}, or Account #<number>), not Account: Sign in

steps.say: press New channel in the chat sidebar
steps.expect: a Create a channel card shows: a Channel name field, Voice room: Off and Members only: Off buttons, and Cancel and Create channel buttons

steps.say: type the channel name into the Channel name field
steps.expect: the Channel name field's value is qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} and Create channel is enabled (its state does not list disabled)
the Create a channel card is gone and the channel list shows a button named for qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} (a leading # is fine); no error sentence

steps.say: press the qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} channel in the channel list
steps.expect: the room header's name label reads qa-keys-{param:walk_tag}; a message composer (a text field named Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag}) shows with a Send button, and no line refuses writing for want of an account

steps.say: type x into the Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} composer (the type action on that field, which puts the caret there)
steps.expect: the Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} composer holds focus (its state lists focused) and the Send button is enabled (its state does not list disabled: the typed x landed); on an app that reports the composer's value it reads x

steps.say: press Backspace (the composer is empty again), then Delete in the empty Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} composer
type x into the Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag} composer (the type action on that field)
steps.expect: after Delete, the chat view is still shown: the New channel button, the room header's name label reading qa-keys-{param:walk_tag}, and the composer (a text field named Message #qa-keys-{param:walk_tag}); no 'This view stopped' title, no Retry button and no error sentence (such as 'guest requested unsupported native editor key'); and the Send button is enabled (its state does not list disabled: the typed x landed, so Delete did not wedge the editor).
